title: IOC consensus statement on Relative Energy Deficiency in Sport (REDs), 2023 update
claims: The 2023 IOC consensus defines energy availability as energy intake minus exercise energy expenditure, divided by fat-free mass per day.
Reported prevalence of low energy availability or REDs indicators ranges from 23% to 79.5% in female athletes and 15% to 70% in male athletes.
The consensus distinguishes low energy availability that is adaptable from problematic low energy availability.
Problematic low energy availability is associated with reduced musculoskeletal health, increased injury risk and impaired performance.
